purpose: Auditable provenance for the design-lens exemplar set (Phase 205 plan 02, D-23). One entry per committed PNG.

version_pin.policy: Version-pinned. Refresh ONLY via a deliberate 're-baseline exemplars' maintainer commit that replaces the PNGs and this manifest together. Never auto-drift from the latest render — a drifting anchor breaks run-to-run comparability.
version_pin.own_render_license: All exemplars are own screenshots of this MIT-licensed repo (accrue_admin) — license-clean by construction (D-19). Third-party dashboards (Linear/Vercel/Prisma/Tailscale/Oban) stay TEXTUAL anchors in DESIGN-LENS-RUBRIC.md; none are committed as images.
version_pin.css_bundle_note: priv/static/accrue_admin.css was rebuilt via `mix accrue_admin.assets.build` (MIX_ENV=test) immediately before capture; the rebuild produced no diff, so PNGs reflect the committed CSS bundle (RESEARCH Pitfall 5).

capture_recipe.server: MIX_ENV=test mix accrue_admin.e2e.server (auto-booted by playwright.config.js webServer; port from ACCRUE_ADMIN_E2E_PORT, default 4017)
capture_recipe.route: POST /__e2e__/reset -> POST /__e2e__/seed/{operator-flows,dashboard,edge-states} -> GET /__e2e__/login?to=<surface> -> data-theme=light -> page.screenshot({ fullPage: false }) at a fixed viewport
capture_recipe.downscale: None required. Captured at a fixed 1280px-wide desktop viewport (the 'fixed-width playwright capture' path), so every PNG is <=1600px wide by construction and well under the 5 MB base64 MAX_B64_BYTES guard. sips/ImageMagick were available but not needed; no npm dependency (no sharp) was added.
capture_recipe.bad_exemplar_method: The admin serves a strict nonce-only CSP, so `<style>`/addStyleTag injection is blocked. Bad poles were produced by deterministic CSSOM mutation (element.style.setProperty(prop, val, 'important')), which CSP's style-src does not govern, over a bounded selector set on the current admin render, then screenshot, then discarded (own-render, no source change committed).
capture_recipe.capture_harness: A throwaway spec (e2e/_ratchet-exemplar-capture.spec.js) was used for capture and removed after curation — it is NOT committed. The reusable capture code with git history is e2e/admin-visuals.spec.js (D-18).

exemplars.curator_note: Correctly-dense operator dashboard (data-dense-operator archetype). The primary suppressor of the density footgun: shows Accrue's real spacing bar for a dense KPI + attention-rail + activity console.
The /dev/components kitchen (foundation archetype). Anchors token-clean primitive spacing/hierarchy for component and component-group surfaces.

exemplars.capture_command: login(/billing) -> CSSOM tighten (line-height 1.05; gaps 1px; div/section/card padding 1px 3px, margin 0; td/th padding 1px 4px; h1-h3 margin 0) -> screenshot(fullPage:false)
exemplars.distortion: Under-spaced / too-tight synthetic distortion of the current dashboard on the current admin (D-19 fallback for cramped, since an old-SHA boot was impractical in this working tree). Reads as cramped: nav rows and sections butt together, no group separation.
exemplars.curator_note: Cramped density pole. Teaches the under-spaced failure mode so the lens does not only learn the wasteful pole.

exemplars.capture_command: login(/billing) -> CSSOM inflate (line-height 2.4; gaps 56px; div/section/card padding 40px 48px, margin 24px 0; td/th padding 34px 44px) -> screenshot(fullPage:false)
exemplars.distortion: Synthetically over-whitespaced dashboard (inflate padding/gaps -> shoot -> revert; no source change committed, D-19). The operator's data is pushed far below the fold; the console reads like a marketing page.
exemplars.curator_note: Wasteful density pole. The direct anti-anchor for the milestone's biggest brand risk: over-whitespacing a correctly-dense console.

exemplars.capture_command: login(/billing) -> CSSOM fintech-glossy (purple/blue/cyan gradient background; serif type; 22px card radius + heavy shadow; 9999px gradient pill CTAs with glow shadow + text-shadow) -> screenshot(fullPage:false)
exemplars.distortion: Off-register / fintech-glossy negative synthesized on the own render (D-19 offered a textual-only fallback; a license-clean own-render was achievable so the PNG ships). Saturated gradients + glossy pill CTAs + rounded-everything + off-brand serif -> the anti-thesis of quiet, well-made developer tooling (D-21).
exemplars.curator_note: Brand-expression (d8) negative anchor. Attach as the BAD exemplar when the design lens probes brand register, independent of surface_type.
